confidence_scheme: Prediction confidence = max(p, 1-p). Three classes: low (<0.65; inconclusive, not reported), intermediate (0.65-0.80; reportable), high (>=0.80; reportable, high confidence). A valid intraoperative call is prespecified as confidence >= valid_call_threshold (0.65); the 0.80 boundary and higher operating points are post-hoc/exploratory. The primary endpoint (AUC) is threshold-free.
